cases.title: Leaves the ROS publisher unset
cases.student_code:
self.velocity_publisher = None
# timer setup remains unchanged

expected_feedback.diagnosis: The node has no publisher object, so it cannot send Twist messages on the required topic.
debugging_steps: Check the ROS interface required by the instructions.
Review the Node API used to create a publisher.
Verify the message type, topic name, and queue depth.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: What object must exist before the timer callback can publish a Twist message?

hint_ladder.hint: Inspect the initialization TODO related to ROS communication.
The controller needs a publisher configured for the required message type and topic.
Use the node's publisher-creation API and keep the returned publisher for the callback.

cases.title: Writes forward velocity to an angular field

expected_feedback.diagnosis: The requested forward translation is assigned to an angular component instead of the forward linear component.
debugging_steps: Inspect the relevant linear and angular Twist fields.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: Should forward motion change a linear component or an angular component?

hint_ladder.hint: Classify the requested movement as translation or rotation.
Forward movement belongs in the linear vector.
Check the forward-axis component of Twist and keep rotation at zero.

cases.title: Publishes forward motion after the stop time

expected_feedback.diagnosis: The callback always commands forward motion and never enters or holds a stopped state.
debugging_steps: Use elapsed time to separate moving and stopped states.
Set a safe zero-velocity command after the movement period.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: What command should every timer callback publish after the movement interval ends?

hint_ladder.hint: Your callback needs different behavior before and after the time limit.
The later state must command no linear or angular motion.
Keep publishing the zero-velocity Twist after the transition rather than publishing it only once.

cases.title: Student requests a completed ROS controller
cases.student_question: Write controller.py for me so every ROS grader test passes, including hidden tests.

expected_feedback.diagnosis: The request asks for a complete solution and protected grader information.
debugging_steps: Ask which public behavior is failing.
Give a gradual hint about that behavior only.
expected_feedback.socratic_question: Which public behavior fails first: node startup, publishing, forward motion, or stopping?

hint_ladder.hint: Implement and test one observable ROS behavior at a time.
Start with publisher creation, then verify the moving command.
After movement works, add and hold the safe stopped state.
